newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Goodman says finds new fin. director.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Goodman says finds new fin. director.

text.p: Australasian food group Goodman Fielder Ltd said on Friday it had secured a new chief financial officer and financial director to replace Les Cullen.
Goodman Fielder chairman David Clarke told the group's annual meeting that the new appointee was an Australian from a top 50 company with experience in manufacturing, but declined to name him.
The company announced in October that Cullen had resigned to pursue other interests.
He said an announcement of the appointee's name would be made within weeks.
"I can assure you that both companies are working together to ensure that there is an amicable transition (for the new executive)," Clarke said.
